notes.title: Update for next demo.
notes.content: [p][b][i]Added new rare cards[/i][/b][/p][olist][*][p]Turret added (targets the nearest ship)[/p][/*][*][p]Triple Shot (adds two more bullets to each shot)[/p][/*][*][p]Teleport (Teleports to where the mouse is aiming)[/p][/*][*][p]Ricochet (Ricochets some bullets for 5 levels)[/p][/*][*][p]Repair + (Now this card restores 60HP to the ship)[/p][/*][/olist][p][b][i]Graphical overhaul of some enemies[/i][/b][/p][p]Now general ships have updated graphics, except for the blue ship, the boss, and the kamikaze.[/p][p][b][i]Player graphical overhaul[/i][/b][/p][p]I believed the player had a good shape, but the colors felt dull; now it’s more vibrant than ever.[/p][p]This also includes the support drones.[/p][p][b][i]Graphical improvement of menu buttons and text[/i][/b][/p][p]When I built the game, the buttons seemed fine but amateur; after some time studying, I improved them.[/p][p][b][i]Black hole bug fix[/i][/b][/p][p]The current bug consisted of the black hole card description having one line misaligned while the other was centered.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611539/dde962ed201705ee46d0b3ae1904fbb52156f3e2.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611539/24f7b1a085e51728970daa783efa8d30812309ad.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611539/dde962ed201705ee46d0b3ae1904fbb52156f3e2.gif"][/img][/p][p]Finally, thank you for your patience! The game will have [b]A NEW DEMO[/b] at the end of this month. And not only that: now that several personal and professional matters are resolved, we have a new release date for the official launch: [b]October 6th[/b].[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who is excited and to those who want to give the game a chance. I’m working as hard as I can to finish it and meet your expectations.[/p]
